'''Slip-jaws''' was a maneuver used by [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] pilots. Slip-jaws consisted of two fighters crossing into each other's paths, almost but not quite crashing into each other, while unfortunate pursuers smash into one another. The maneuver was possible only for [[Droid/Legends|droid]] pilots or those aided by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], as it required an extraordinary level of precision. Slip-jaws was named after the scissor-like mandibles of a [[Kashyyyk slash-spider]].

[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] utilized this technique during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle over Coruscant]] to escape [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droids]] who were pursuing them.
